result.summary: The home screen is mostly usable, but several layout and content bugs cut off text, hide a category chip, and show a typo in search.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in “Fastest near you” (Trattoria Piccol…) is clipped on the right, so the name and part of the image are cut off.
issues.suggestion: Give the horizontal list enough padding/peek so the last card is fully visible, or make the row scroll with a clear overflow affordance.

issues.description: The “Healthy” category chip is cut off at the right edge of the screen, so the filter list looks incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Add end padding or a fade/scroll hint so the last chip is fully readable, and allow horizontal scrolling if there are more categories.

issues.description: Search placeholder is misspelled as “Restarants, dishes, groceries”.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder to “Restaurants, dishes, groceries”.

issues.description: The second Popular card (pizza with −20%) is cropped by the bottom navigation, so the restaurant name and details are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/safe-area inset so content can scroll fully above the tab bar.

issues.description: Promo banner copy “3 free deliveries for you” sits very close to the top edge of the green card.
issues.suggestion: Increase top padding inside the banner so the headline is not cramped.
